ops.h: ไข้ร่วมกับตัวเหลือง (Fever with jaundice)
ops.html:
• Infection — Hepatobiliary infection: Viral hepatitis, Liver abscess, Cholangitis, Cholecystitis with CBD stone
  • Infection — Systemic infection: Virus (Infectious mononucleosis) · Severe bacterial sepsis (Streptococcus, Klebseilla, E. coli, Salmonella) · Mycobacteria (Miliary TB) · Tropical dz (Leptospirosis, Melioidosis, Malaria)
  • Infection — Sepsis with other cause of jaundice: Hemolytic jaundice (HbH, HS, AIHA) · Hepatocellular jaundice (Liver cirrhosis, Medication toxicity: Rifam, INH, Gilbert syndrome, Dubin-Johson, Rotor syndrome)
  • Non-Infection: Lymphoma, Alcoholic hepatitis, Malignant histiocytosis, Hemophagocytic syndrome
